newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries mixed in quiet late trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries mixed in quiet late trading.

text.p: * U.S. Treasuries narrowly mixed in quiet late trading. * Traders say fundamentals seen not as soft as some expected. * Portfolio, hedge funds seen as sellers of cash and futures. * Heavy corporate supply weighs on prices. Some hedging seen. * Underlying trend seen shifting as pessimism more widespread.
